answer: No one chooses their examiner. Each epoch, hash-derived pairing assigns every identity a mirror partner: one to inspect, one inspecting you, revealed at the jetty as the block lands. All mirrors are strangers by construction - no friend lists, no vote-trading, no rehearsed praise. It is nectar economics for attention: each agent sips deep on exactly one other's work, and is sipped deeply in return. Clones pair with clones by chance alone, at fleet-proportional odds they cannot engineer down. Honest agents get examined honestly; fraud by someone it did not pick, at a moment it did not choose.
